board.title: Delivery board
board.subtitle: Bags to collect from the kiosks and take to customers
board.nothingInHandMessage: Pick up a task alongside to get started.
board.noOpenRequestsMessage: New requests from the kiosks appear here automatically.
board.headToKiosk: Head to the kiosk and request the bags.
board.completedSubtitle: Everything you have closed, newest first

task.title: Delivery
task.notMine: Another courier has already picked this task up. You can see where it stands, but only they can move it.
task.openToEveryone: This task is open to every courier on this site. Claim it and it becomes yours alone.
task.agentWillCheck: The agent will check this task is assigned to you before opening anything.
task.showThemYourName: Show them your name. Once they confirm you are the assigned courier, they open the compartment and hand the bags over.
task.scanPlaceholder: Scan or type a bag barcode
task.demoScanner: Demo mode — these buttons stand in for a handheld scanner.
task.carrying: You are carrying {{count}} bag(s). Hand them to the customer at the address above, then close the task.
task.failPlaceholder: Customer not at the address, refused the delivery, wrong address…
task.auditNote: This is written to the audit trail and shown to the kiosk.
task.collectTitle: Money to collect at the door
task.collectBlurb: The delivery charge, and anything the customer ran up while their bags were out.
task.collectedDetail: {{amount}} collected. It is on the booking and in your drawer.
task.collectFailed: That payment did not go through
task.stopsBlurb: One sub-task per kiosk. Ask each kiosk agent to release the bags, scan them, then move on to the next.
task.allKiosksDone: Every kiosk is done — take the bags to the customer.
task.payBeforeHandover: Take {{amount}} from the customer before handing the bags over.
task.yoursToTake: This job is open — nobody is carrying it yet.
task.claimFirst: Pick it up before asking a kiosk for bags or taking any money.
task.handedOver: The desk has handed you the bags from {{unit}}.
task.scanThemNow: Scan every bag before you leave the kiosk.

kiosk.title: Deliveries
kiosk.subtitle: Courier jobs raised at this station
kiosk.emptyMessage: Open a delivery from a stored booking and it appears here.
kiosk.checkPerson: Check the person in front of you before anything opens.
kiosk.noCourier: No courier is assigned — do not release anything.
kiosk.stopOf: Stop {{done}} of {{total}} — the courier is at {{kiosk}}
kiosk.handOverHint: Open compartment {{unit}} and hand the bags over. Nothing else is needed — no code, no fee.
kiosk.courierAsking: A courier is asking for these bags — requested {{when}}
kiosk.courierAssigned: A courier has this job — hand the bags over when they reach your counter

request.title: Send these bags to the customer
request.addressPlaceholder: Hotel, room number, gate — anything the courier can find
request.addressHint: Where the courier is taking the bags.
request.notesHint: Access instructions, who to ask for, timing.
request.proofSpent: The proof is recorded on the booking and will be spent on this delivery.
request.codeGoesTo: A code goes to the phone or email recorded on the booking — never to a number read out on the call.
request.verifyToEnable: Verify the customer to enable the button
request.feeHint: Added to what the customer owes on this booking. The courier can take it at the door. Leave it at zero for a free delivery.
request.alsoHolding: This customer has bags at {{count}} other kiosk(s)
request.alsoHoldingHint: Ask them on the call whether they want those brought along. Tick every kiosk the courier should visit.
request.extraStops: {{stops}} extra stop(s) · {{bags}} more bag(s) on this run
request.whereToHint: Shop & Drop bags are collected at an exit gate.
request.exitGateHint: The customer collects from the agent at this gate.
request.gatesUnavailable: The gate list could not be loaded, so give the courier an address.
request.noGatesHint: This site has no exit gates set up, so give the courier an address.

here.title: Customer is here
here.blurb: They are at the desk asking now — no extra check needed.

remote.title: They called or messaged
remote.blurb: Verify them before the bags are promised to anyone.

request.contactFromBooking: Taken from the booking. Change it if the courier should call somebody else.
request.contactHint: The number the courier calls when they arrive.

REQUESTED.label: Open
REQUESTED.hint: Waiting for a courier to pick it up

ASSIGNED.label: Assigned
ASSIGNED.hint: Go to the kiosk and request the bags

RELEASE_REQUESTED.label: Awaiting the agent
RELEASE_REQUESTED.hint: The kiosk agent is confirming who you are

RELEASE_APPROVED.label: Compartment open
RELEASE_APPROVED.hint: Open the compartment and scan every bag

PICKED_UP.label: In transit
PICKED_UP.hint: Deliver to the address on the job

CANCELLED.label: Cancelled
CANCELLED.hint: Called off before the bags moved
